verdict.rationale: Phaser ships an extensive, versioned public JS/TS API (Scenes, physics, input, loader, animations) documented at docs.phaser.io with full TypeScript definitions, which is exactly the kind of documented public API an AI agent needs to generate/drive game code programmatically; the runtime probe also shows phaser.io/llms.txt now serving a live, programmatic examples-API index tailored for AI consumption. Missing for 10: a formal machine-readable spec (OpenAPI) for the core API surface — probes show OpenAPI/swagger endpoints all 404 — so discovery still relies on human-oriented docs rather than a fully machine-consumable contract.
